correctness.rationale: Direct evaluation of concave quadratic maxima gives containment. Both axial-tip and two-latitude branches have exact weighted mean-zero isotropic contact sets, certifying global unrestricted John optimality and uniqueness. Tip validity decreases strictly, with the sole sharp threshold; root existence follows by continuous endpoints and John uniqueness. Exact squared-latitude equation, bracketing and algebraic asymptotics prove the three regimes. A standalone standard-library checker validates 320 instances with small errors but is not the proof.
